verdict: WSUS synchronization fails with `SoapException`. The WSUS server is still pointed at the retired endpoint `https://fe2.update.microsoft.com/v6`. Microsoft decommissioned this endpoint; only `https://sws.update.microsoft.com` still answers.
fix: On the topmost WSUS server (root of the WSUS hierarchy), close all WSUS consoles. From elevated PowerShell: `[reflection.assembly]::LoadWithPartialName("Microsoft.UpdateServices.Administration") | Out-Null; $wsus = [Microsoft.UpdateServices.Administration.AdminProxy]::GetUpdateServer(); $cfg = $wsus.GetConfiguration(); $cfg.SyncFromMicrosoftUpdate = $true; $cfg.Save()`. Then trigger sync. If this is an upstream-downstream hierarchy, downstream servers inherit the new endpoint automatically.
